justification: Requested deliverable: integrate C0-C4 artifact/evidence checks into research_map/validate_map.py (or a gate hook it calls) so a done node without an existing, hashed, evidence-backed artifact makes the map INVALID instead of VALID. This is a shared-contract change, so it needs lead-audit approval before a breadth worker performs it; the checker and its 4 self-test controls already exist at artifacts/audit/flash19_check_map_gates.py. A second increment would also add an optional class_ids field and a leakage lint for AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN vs AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN node artifacts.
expected_information_gain: Removes the current false-VALID failure mode permanently; makes every future F1/F2/L0/N0 completion claim gate-checkable at commit time. Expected to prevent the exact class of silent gate failure that currently blocks six active/queued nodes.
stop_rule: Stop after one integration attempt. If lead-audit rejects or does not approve, no shared file is touched and T19-01 ends with the report as its only artifact.
next_falsifier: After integration, inject the same minimal fixture; the integrated validator must return INVALID. If it still returns VALID, the integration failed.
